confidence_rationale: The co-constitutive dACC partner for the FPC counterfactual signal: Kolling et al show ACC encodes the value of SEARCHING for / SWITCHING to alternatives (the average value of the foraging environment + search cost), in a distinct reference frame from vmPFC's encoding of specific chosen-option value. This is the dACC<->vmPFC/FPC value division that MECH-264's switch-to-alternative gate presupposes. Confidence moderate-high: strong human fMRI with a clean dissociation, but the paper localises switch-value to ACC (REE's SD-032b dACC-analog), so it grounds the LOOP PARTNER of SD-033e/MECH-264 rather than the frontopolar node itself.
failure_signatures: Kolling et al place switch/search value in ACC, not lateral FPC. If a V4 implementation puts the entire counterfactual-and-switch computation inside an SD-033e frontopolar-analog with no dACC-analog (SD-032b) partner, it would conflate two anatomically and reference-frame-distinct signals -- the chosen-option value (vmPFC/FPC) and the environment/search value (ACC).

A later re-analysis (Shenhav/Hayden debate) argued some ACC 'foraging value' effects reflect choice difficulty rather than a dedicated search-value signal; if REE's switch gate fires on difficulty/conflict alone, it would reproduce the confound rather than a genuine counterfactual-value comparison.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Humans alternate between two modes of choice -- comparative decision-making (vmPFC, encoding values of specific well-defined options) and foraging (ACC, encoding the average value of the environment and the cost of foraging/searching for alternatives) -- using distinct neural substrates with distinct reference frames.
mapping.ree_translation: MECH-264's switch-to-alternative signal is the REE analog of the ACC foraging-value computation: a running estimate of the value of leaving the current course for an alternative, compared against the chosen-option value. The dACC-analog (SD-032b) supplies the environment/search-value side and the SD-033e frontopolar-analog supplies the specific counterfactual-option value; together they form the co-constitutive dACC<->FPC arbitration loop that gates slot-switching in SD-046's multi-slot GoalState.
mapping.mapping_caveat: The paper's switch-value signal is in ACC, not FPC; it grounds the PARTNER node (SD-032b) and the loop, not MECH-264's frontopolar locus directly. MECH-264 is tagged because the switch-to-alternative GATE it specifies is exactly what ACC foraging value drives -- but the per-option counterfactual value MECH-264 maintains is the Boorman 2009 FPC signal, not this one. Treat as loop-level grounding.
mapping.source_context: Human fMRI; sequential foraging vs comparative-choice paradigm; healthy adults.

confidence_components.notes: Strong human fMRI (Science, Rushworth lab, clean vmPFC/ACC dissociation). Mapping_fidelity moderate: grounds the dACC-FPC LOOP and the switch-value side, but the locus is ACC (SD-032b) not FPC (SD-033e); MECH-264 tagged for the switch-gate it drives. Transfer_risk standard human->agent. The Hayden/Shenhav difficulty-confound debate is logged as a failure signature.
